analysis:
Reviewed both primary analyses against the replayed patches, metadata, policy source and canonical threat-model index, including detailed T-041. No independently supported security regression was established.

EngineV2KVBackendPolicy.swift:38–42 adds the exact Flint artifact to automatic paged selection. Overrides, kill switch, capability vetoes and failure policy remain unchanged in the visible source. EngineV2KVBackendPolicyTests.swift:258–269 expects increased automatic serving width on selected M5 tiers; this expands default execution exposure but does not establish a memory-admission bypass.

FlintNativeProtocolConstraint.swift:148–162 adds state-keyed mask caching and enables chained decoding. FlintAnswerStopConstraint.swift:72–92 delegates scanning keys and chained eligibility, reserving -1 for matched masks. FlintAnswerStopTests.swift:197–209 checks mask equality for shared keys, not sampler behavior. No visible evidence demonstrates mask collisions, output disclosure or weakened authorization. No supplied patch directly changes transport encryption, attestation, credentials, billing, SSD cryptography or privileged-helper authority.

Material uncertainty remains at libs/mlx-swift-lm:1: the dependency revision changes without implementation contents. Review its sampler for request/constraint-local cache namespaces, negative-key support, bounded mask retention, exhaustion invalidation, and speculative redraw/termination based on confirmed transition state rather than mask-key equality. Scanning states may share masks while differing in stop progress. Validate cancellation and token accounting, plus Flint's wider concurrency against actual KV/process admission and account-scoped cache bindings (TB-007, TB-002, A-001, T-007, T-010, T-028, T-041). These are unverified integration contracts, not observed missing controls. Replay omits nine previously reviewed source units; documentation equivalence claims and prior analyses cannot resolve these questions. Further review of the changed SDK and serving integration is required.
